records.key: Advisory only — nothing here changes a setting until you press Use.
records.source: Advisory only — nothing here changes a setting until you press Use.
records.translation: Aðeins til leiðbeiningar — ekkert hér breytir stillingu fyrr en þú ýtir á Nota.

records.key: Advisory only — this never stops Measure from running.
records.source: Advisory only — this never stops Measure from running.
records.translation: Aðeins til leiðbeiningar — þetta stöðvar aldrei keyrslu Measure.

records.key: Background of an exported figure ('none' leaves the page showing through)
records.source: Background of an exported figure ('none' leaves the page showing through)
records.translation: Bakgrunnur útfluttrar myndar ('none' lætur síðuna sjást í gegn)

records.key: Boolean column marking the non-targeting controls, for the 'control' method
records.source: Boolean column marking the non-targeting controls, for the 'control' method
records.translation: Boole-dálkur sem merkir viðmið sem beinast ekki að neinu geni, fyrir aðferðina 'control'

records.key: Cellpose 4 rescales every image by 30/diameter before it segments, so a diameter two-fold off moves your objects out of the size cpsam works at. This reads a few fields of your own data and measures it — Cellpose is not loaded.
records.source: Cellpose 4 rescales every image by 30/diameter before it segments, so a diameter two-fold off moves your objects out of the size cpsam works at. This reads a few fields of your own data and measures it — Cellpose is not loaded.
records.translation: Cellpose 4 endurkvarðar hverja mynd með 30/þvermál áður en hún er bútuð, svo þvermál sem skeikar um tvöfalt færir hlutina þína út fyrir þá stærð sem cpsam vinnur við. Þetta les nokkur sjónsvið úr þínum eigin gögnum og mælir þau — Cellpose er ekki hlaðið.

records.key: Choose a regression results folder — the one holding results_gene.csv.
records.source: Choose a regression results folder — the one holding results_gene.csv.
records.translation: Veldu möppu með aðhvarfsniðurstöðum — þá sem inniheldur results_gene.csv.

records.key: Choose a spaCR project folder to draw what it has produced.
records.source: Choose a spaCR project folder to draw what it has produced.
records.translation: Veldu spaCR verkefnismöppu til að teikna upp það sem hún hefur framleitt.

records.key: Choose a spaCR project folder to list the runs it recorded.
records.source: Choose a spaCR project folder to list the runs it recorded.
records.translation: Veldu spaCR verkefnismöppu til að birta lista yfir keyrslurnar sem hún skráði.

records.key: Colour of the axis lines, the ticks and the text
records.source: Colour of the axis lines, the ticks and the text

records.key: Column naming each row's gene, for the compartment lookup
records.source: Column naming each row's gene, for the compartment lookup
records.translation: Dálkur sem tilgreinir gen hverrar raðar, fyrir uppflettingu á frumuhólfi

records.key: Column plotted on the x axis
records.source: Column plotted on the x axis
records.translation: Dálkur sem teiknaður er á x-ásinn

records.key: Column plotted on the y axis
records.source: Column plotted on the y axis
records.translation: Dálkur sem teiknaður er á y-ásinn
Dálkur sem ræður lit hvers punkts
Dálkur sem ræður lögun hvers punkts

records.key: Diameter — measure it, do not guess it
records.source: Diameter — measure it, do not guess it
records.translation: Þvermál — mældu það, ekki giska á það

records.key: Effect-size cut used when the method is 'value'; automatic draws no effect-size line at all
records.source: Effect-size cut used when the method is 'value'; automatic draws no effect-size line at all
records.translation: Viðmiðsgildi áhrifastærðar sem notað er þegar aðferðin er 'value'; sjálfvirkt teiknar enga línu fyrir áhrifastærð

records.key: End of page — all crops labelled. Press Enter to load the next batch.
records.source: End of page — all crops labelled. Press Enter to load the next batch.
records.translation: Síðulok — allir myndbútar merktir. Ýttu á Enter til að hlaða inn næsta skammti.

records.key: End of page — press Enter to load the next batch.
records.source: End of page — press Enter to load the next batch.
records.translation: Síðulok — ýttu á Enter til að hlaða inn næsta skammti.

records.key: Every line in the file: the plotted curves, the reference lines, the axis spines and the tick marks. The numbers beside the ticks are text and follow the text colour.
records.source: Every line in the file: the plotted curves, the reference lines, the axis spines and the tick marks. The numbers beside the ticks are text and follow the text colour.
records.translation: Allar línur í skránni: teiknaðir ferlar, viðmiðunarlínur, áslínur og kvarðastrik. Tölurnar við kvarðastrikin eru texti og fylgja textalitnum.

records.key: Every piece of text in the file: the title, the axis labels, the numbers beside the ticks and the legend.
records.source: Every piece of text in the file: the title, the axis labels, the numbers beside the ticks and the legend.
records.translation: Allur texti í skránni: titillinn, ásamerkingar, tölurnar við kvarðastrikin og skýringarnar.

records.key: High end of the colour scale
records.source: High end of the colour scale

records.key: How fast the animation moves, against the speed each one was designed at. It applies to every kind of motion in the chosen animation at once, and changing it never makes what is already on screen jump.
records.source: How fast the animation moves, against the speed each one was designed at. It applies to every kind of motion in the chosen animation at once, and changing it never makes what is already on screen jump.
records.translation: Hversu hratt hreyfimyndin hreyfist, miðað við hraðann sem hver og ein var hönnuð fyrir. Það á við um allar tegundir hreyfingar í valinni hreyfimynd í einu, og breyting á því lætur aldrei það sem þegar er á skjánum hoppa.

records.key: How large the moving elements are: blob width, curtain height, the spacing between ripples, star size, cell diameter. Scaled against each animation's own range, so one setting means the same thing in all of them.
records.source: How large the moving elements are: blob width, curtain height, the spacing between ripples, star size, cell diameter. Scaled against each animation's own range, so one setting means the same thing in all of them.
records.translation: Hversu stórir hreyfanlegu hlutarnir eru: breidd klessna, hæð tjalda, bil milli gára, stærð stjarna, þvermál frumna. Kvarðað miðað við eigið bil hverrar hreyfimyndar, svo sama stilling þýðir það sama í þeim öllum.

records.key: How many things there are: blobs, aurora curtains, ripple sources, stars, bokeh discs, cells. Density and detail share one cost budget, so asking for the most of both trims the density rather than dropping frames.
records.source: How many things there are: blobs, aurora curtains, ripple sources, stars, bokeh discs, cells. Density and detail share one cost budget, so asking for the most of both trims the density rather than dropping frames.
records.translation: Hversu margir hlutir eru: klessur, norðurljósatjöld, gárulindir, stjörnur, bokeh-skífur, frumur. Þéttleiki og smáatriði deila einu kostnaðarþaki, svo ef beðið er um hámark af hvoru tveggja minnkar þéttleikinn í stað þess að rammar falli niður.

records.key: How much detail the animation is drawn with. This is the one that decides whether it looks pixelated: it sets how many pixels the picture is worked out in before it is stretched to fill the page. Costs roughly the square of what it says — 200 % is four times the work — so turn it down on a machine that is busy.
records.source: How much detail the animation is drawn with. This is the one that decides whether it looks pixelated: it sets how many pixels the picture is worked out in before it is stretched to fill the page. Costs roughly the square of what it says — 200 % is four times the work — so turn it down on a machine that is busy.
records.translation: Hversu mikil smáatriði hreyfimyndin er teiknuð með. Þessi stilling ræður því hvort hún virðist kornótt: hún ákveður í hversu mörgum dílum myndin er reiknuð áður en hún er teygð til að fylla síðuna. Kostnaðurinn er um það bil gildið í öðru veldi — 200 % er fjórföld vinna — svo lækkaðu hana á vél sem er undir álagi.

records.key: How out of focus the animation is, on top of whatever detail it was drawn with. 0 % leaves it as sharp as the detail setting allows; 100 % is the softness the animations used to ship with. Unlike detail, this one is nearly free — and the two together are what let the backdrop be soft without being blocky.
records.source: How out of focus the animation is, on top of whatever detail it was drawn with. 0 % leaves it as sharp as the detail setting allows; 100 % is the softness the animations used to ship with. Unlike detail, this one is nearly free — and the two together are what let the backdrop be soft without being blocky.
records.translation: Hversu úr fókus hreyfimyndin er, ofan á þau smáatriði sem hún var teiknuð með. 0 % skilur hana eftir eins skarpa og smáatriðastillingin leyfir; 100 % er sú mýkt sem hreyfimyndirnar voru áður afhentar með. Ólíkt smáatriðum kostar þessi stilling nánast ekkert — og saman gera þær bakgrunninum kleift að vera mjúkur án þess að verða kubbóttur.

records.key: How the effect-size cut is derived
records.source: How the effect-size cut is derived

records.translation: Hleður inn meðfylgjandi genaskýringum fyrir Toxoplasma…

records.key: Loading was cancelled; the run already on screen is unchanged.
records.source: Loading was cancelled; the run already on screen is unchanged.
records.translation: Hætt var við hleðslu; keyrslan sem þegar er á skjánum er óbreytt.

records.key: Low end of the colour scale
records.source: Low end of the colour scale

records.key: Multiplier applied to the rule above (the quantile itself when the method is 'quantile')
records.source: Multiplier applied to the rule above (the quantile itself when the method is 'quantile')
records.translation: Margfaldari sem beitt er á regluna hér að ofan (sjálft fraktílið þegar aðferðin er 'quantile')

records.key: Name at least one source, then build the digest.
records.source: Name at least one source, then build the digest.
records.translation: Tilgreindu að minnsta kosti eina uppsprettu og búðu síðan til samantektina.

records.key: No coefficient in this screen carries a TAGM/LOPIT localisation, so there is nothing to colour by.
records.source: No coefficient in this screen carries a TAGM/LOPIT localisation, so there is nothing to colour by.
records.translation: Enginn stuðull í þessari skimun hefur TAGM/LOPIT staðsetningu, svo það er ekkert til að lita eftir.

records.key: No gene number could be parsed out of this term, so there is no annotation to look up.
records.source: No gene number could be parsed out of this term, so there is no annotation to look up.
records.translation: Ekki tókst að lesa neitt genanúmer úr þessu heiti, svo það er engin genaskýring til að fletta upp.

records.key: No object channel is set. Fill in cell_channel, nucleus_channel or pathogen_channel — they are 0-based indices into the sorted channel IDs — and measure again.
records.source: No object channel is set. Fill in cell_channel, nucleus_channel or pathogen_channel — they are 0-based indices into the sorted channel IDs — and measure again.
records.translation: Engin hlutarás er stillt. Fylltu út cell_channel, nucleus_channel eða pathogen_channel — þetta eru 0-byggðir vísar í röðuð rásaauðkenni — og mældu aftur.

records.key: Nothing on this page to annotate.
records.source: Nothing on this page to annotate.
records.translation: Ekkert á þessari síðu til að merkja.

records.key: Nothing to annotate — open a source first.
records.source: Nothing to annotate — open a source first.
records.translation: Ekkert til að merkja — opnaðu fyrst uppsprettu.

records.key: Nothing to delete: these runs have no folder on disk.
records.source: Nothing to delete: these runs have no folder on disk.
records.translation: Ekkert til að eyða: þessar keyrslur eiga enga möppu á diskinum.

records.key: Nothing was handed to the results panel, so there is no folder to search. Use “Load results…”.
records.source: Nothing was handed to the results panel, so there is no folder to search. Use “Load results…”.
records.translation: Ekkert var sent á niðurstöðuspjaldið, svo það er engin mappa til að leita í. Notaðu „Hlaða niðurstöðum…“.

records.key: Only one run is recorded here, so there is nothing to compare it against yet.
records.source: Only one run is recorded here, so there is nothing to compare it against yet.
records.translation: Aðeins ein keyrsla er skráð hér, svo það er ekkert til að bera hana saman við enn.

records.key: Open a field in napari first.
records.source: Open a field in napari first.

records.key: Pick a method and press Embed and score. Nothing is computed until then.
records.source: Pick a method and press Embed and score. Nothing is computed until then.
records.translation: Veldu aðferð og ýttu á Ívefja og meta. Ekkert er reiknað fyrr en þá.

records.key: Point src at a plate folder first — there is nothing to measure yet.
records.source: Point src at a plate folder first — there is nothing to measure yet.
records.translation: Láttu src fyrst vísa á plötumöppu — það er ekkert til að mæla enn.

records.key: Points labelled by name (set by clicking a point)
records.source: Points labelled by name (set by clicking a point)
records.translation: Punktar merktir með nafni (stillt með því að smella á punkt)

records.key: Sample the reads of one sample and measure every reference table against them, in both orientations and in both mates.
records.source: Sample the reads of one sample and measure every reference table against them, in both orientations and in both mates.
records.translation: Taktu úrtak af lestrum eins sýnis og mældu hverja viðmiðunartöflu á móti þeim, í báðar áttir og í báðum lestrum parsins.

records.key: Saved — this is the last page.
records.source: Saved — this is the last page.

records.key: Search every setting in this module by name, by label, or by what its description says it does.
records.source: Search every setting in this module by name, by label, or by what its description says it does.
records.translation: Leitaðu í öllum stillingum þessarar einingar eftir heiti, merki eða því sem lýsingin segir að þær geri.
Veldu eina marktæka niðurstöðu til að rannsaka.

records.key: Show only the settings that no longer hold this module's default value.
records.source: Show only the settings that no longer hold this module's default value.
records.translation: Sýna aðeins stillingar sem hafa ekki lengur sjálfgefið gildi þessarar einingar.

records.key: Stop the search. What it has measured so far stays on screen, and nothing is proposed from a search that was interrupted.
records.source: Stop the search. What it has measured so far stays on screen, and nothing is proposed from a search that was interrupted.
records.translation: Stöðva leitina. Það sem hún hefur mælt hingað til helst á skjánum og ekkert er lagt til út frá leit sem var rofin.

records.key: The digest could not be built.
records.source: The digest could not be built.
records.translation: Ekki tókst að búa til samantektina.

records.key: The draft could not be produced.
records.source: The draft could not be produced.
records.translation: Ekki tókst að búa til drögin.

records.key: The gene could not be resolved, so there is nothing to look up. The plot is unaffected.
records.source: The gene could not be resolved, so there is nothing to look up. The plot is unaffected.
records.translation: Ekki tókst að bera kennsl á genið, svo það er ekkert til að fletta upp. Grafið verður ekki fyrir áhrifum.

records.key: The graph could not be built.
records.source: The graph could not be built.
records.translation: Ekki tókst að búa til grafið.

records.key: The hit list could not be built.
records.source: The hit list could not be built.
records.translation: Ekki tókst að búa til lista yfir marktækar niðurstöður.

records.key: The page behind the figure. Transparent takes whatever the figure is placed on, which is what a slide usually wants.
records.source: The page behind the figure. Transparent takes whatever the figure is placed on, which is what a slide usually wants.
records.translation: Síðan á bak við myndina. Gegnsætt tekur við því sem myndin er sett á, sem er yfirleitt það sem glæra þarf.

records.key: The percentile mapped to black. Raise it to crush more background; 0 keeps the dimmest pixel.
records.source: The percentile mapped to black. Raise it to crush more background; 0 keeps the dimmest pixel.
records.translation: Hundraðshlutamarkið sem varpast á svart. Hækkaðu það til að bæla meiri bakgrunn; 0 heldur daufasta dílnum.

records.key: The percentile mapped to white. Lower it for more contrast at the cost of clipping the brightest pixels; 100 clips none.
records.source: The percentile mapped to white. Lower it for more contrast at the cost of clipping the brightest pixels; 100 clips none.
records.translation: Hundraðshlutamarkið sem varpast á hvítt. Lækkaðu það til að fá meiri birtuskil á kostnað þess að björtustu dílarnir klippist; 100 klippir enga.

records.key: The results table is empty: it has columns but no rows, so the fit produced no coefficients.
records.source: The results table is empty: it has columns but no rows, so the fit produced no coefficients.
records.translation: Niðurstöðutaflan er tóm: hún hefur dálka en engar raðir, svo líkanið skilaði engum stuðlum.

records.key: The run finished, but its settings name no output folder -- src, count_data and score_data are all empty -- so there is nowhere to look for a results table. Use “Load results…” to point at one.
records.source: The run finished, but its settings name no output folder -- src, count_data and score_data are all empty -- so there is nowhere to look for a results table. Use “Load results…” to point at one.
records.translation: Keyrslunni er lokið, en stillingar hennar tilgreina enga úttaksmöppu -- src, count_data og score_data eru öll tóm -- svo það er hvergi hægt að leita að niðurstöðutöflu. Notaðu „Hlaða niðurstöðum…“ til að vísa á eina.

records.key: The run loader came back with nothing, which is a bug in the loader rather than in the run.
records.source: The run loader came back with nothing, which is a bug in the loader rather than in the run.
records.translation: Hleðsluforrit keyrslna skilaði engu, sem er villa í hleðsluforritinu frekar en í keyrslunni.

records.key: The run this was showing has been deleted. Pick another in the Runs tab.
records.source: The run this was showing has been deleted. Pick another in the Runs tab.
records.translation: Keyrslunni sem var sýnd hér hefur verið eytt. Veldu aðra í flipanum Keyrslur.

records.key: There is no graph to copy yet.
records.source: There is no graph to copy yet.
records.translation: Það er ekkert graf til að afrita enn.

records.key: There is no hit list to export yet.
records.source: There is no hit list to export yet.
records.translation: Það er enginn listi yfir marktækar niðurstöður til að flytja út enn.

records.key: There is no settings store to save a default into.
records.source: There is no settings store to save a default into.
records.translation: Það er engin stillingageymsla til að vista sjálfgefið gildi í.

records.key: There is nothing to copy yet.
records.source: There is nothing to copy yet.
records.translation: Það er ekkert til að afrita enn.

records.key: There is nothing to export yet.
records.source: There is nothing to export yet.
records.translation: Það er ekkert til að flytja út enn.

records.key: What spaCR knows about the gene appears here — product, topology, compartment, fitness screens and stage expression.
records.source: What spaCR knows about the gene appears here — product, topology, compartment, fitness screens and stage expression.
records.translation: Það sem spaCR veit um genið birtist hér — afurð, grannfræði, frumuhólf, hæfniskimanir og tjáning eftir lífsstigum.

records.key: Where the y axis is split (set by ticking the split above)
records.source: Where the y axis is split (set by ticking the split above)
records.translation: Hvar y-ásnum er skipt (stillt með því að haka við skiptinguna hér að ofan)

records.key: Write the proposed settings into the form. Nothing is written until this is pressed.
records.source: Write the proposed settings into the form. Nothing is written until this is pressed.
records.translation: Skrifa tillögðu stillingarnar inn í eyðublaðið. Ekkert er skrifað fyrr en ýtt er á þetta.

records.key: parses — load a table to see the values
records.source: parses — load a table to see the values
records.translation: túlkun tókst — hlaðið inn töflu til að sjá gildin

records.key: spaCR did NOT restart: the module and its settings could not be saved, and restarting without them would lose more than the stuck run. Nothing was stopped. The log says why.
records.source: spaCR did NOT restart: the module and its settings could not be saved, and restarting without them would lose more than the stuck run. Nothing was stopped. The log says why.
records.translation: spaCR endurræstist EKKI: ekki tókst að vista eininguna og stillingar hennar, og endurræsing án þeirra myndi tapa meiru en fastu keyrslunni. Ekkert var stöðvað. Atvikaskráin segir hvers vegna.

records.key: type an expression, then press Enter
records.source: type an expression, then press Enter
records.translation: sláðu inn segð og ýttu svo á Enter
